The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 2028 presidential field remains wide open more than two years before primaries, with no candidate exceeding a 23 percent share and the top five contenders separated by roughly 14 points. Trader consensus assigns JD Vance the highest probability, reflecting his current vice-presidential role and early Republican visibility, while Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Marco Rubio sit in the low teens amid Democratic and Republican name recognition. Midterm results, congressional positioning, and any 2026 special-election outcomes could begin to consolidate support, but the absence of declared candidacies or major polling aggregates keeps probabilities dispersed. Late-breaking developments such as cabinet shifts, health events, or primary endorsements retain potential to reorder the market before Iowa voting begins.
